description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'ClaimEventSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends a base filter parameters class and is used to encapsulate filtering criteria (such as name, status, and id) for searching claim events in the system. It also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: ClaimEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters (name, status, id) used in searching claim events, including allowed sort fields and default sort initialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets default sort field to 'claimEvent.name'.
